items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: taking guys like Marty Marcella and... Well, Darnell Howard, of course, who always played in the wrong style.

ctx.x: Well, I listened to the Ori interview that Naz did. Did you ever hear that one? No. Well, Ori talks about it and he says all that was so beautifully arranged and everything except that he wasn't reading his part. No, Ori knew all that stuff. Ori knew all that stuff. Sure. But some of it was new to him, I'm sure. But he knew it almost immediately. He could just listen and grab it right away somehow. Yeah, Ori... Because he had such an ear, or had such an ear, I don't know. I haven't heard his recent records.

Yeah, no, all his... I haven't heard the more up to date stuff. I've heard some of it. Some of it's very good. Ori has got kind of a contemporary sound to his band. It's fantastic. Ori is really a disciplinarian because he can take the modern cats and make them play the way he wants them to. So his bands, even with modern piano players, have that common Ori sound. I can't understand it. You know, taking guys like Marty Marcella and... Well, Darnell Howard, of course, who always played in the wrong style. But…
Well, what about... Do you think that your band has had any effect on the Minneapolis listening public?
